name: append-rows
description: Adds rows to the end of a tab in a Google Sheets spreadsheet (append rows). The spreadsheet can be a URL copied from the browser or an id from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets; tab names come from google-sheets__list-tabs. Each row is an array of cells in column order, or an object keyed by the header names google-sheets__read-rows answers.

spreadsheet.description: The spreadsheet URL copied from the browser, or its ID from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets.

tab.description: The name of the tab to add rows to, from google-sheets__list-tabs.

rows.description: Rows to append. Each row is either an array of cell values in column order or an object keyed by the tab's header cells.
